final: SELECT f.orderslink, o.dealedge, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate), COUNT(*) AS record_count, AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) - s.side_avg AS difference FROM fees AS f JOIN orders AS o ON CAST(o.recordvault AS TEXT) = CAST(f.orderslink AS TEXT) WHERE f.feerate > 0.0009 GROUP BY f.orderslink, o.dealedge HAVING AVG(f.feerate - f.rebrate) > (SELECT AVG(group_avg) FROM (SELECT AVG(f2.feerate - f2.rebrate) AS group_avg FROM fees AS f2 JOIN orders AS o2 ON CAST(o2.recordvault AS TEXT) = CAST(f2.orderslink AS TEXT) WHERE f2.feerate > 0.0009 AND o2.dealedge = o.dealedge GROUP BY f2.orderslink, o2.dealedge)) ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
